description: This file defines the NoteMapper class responsible for converting between Note entity and its corresponding DTOs (NoteRequest and NoteResponse). It provides methods to create a Note from a request, update an existing Note, and generate a response DTO from a Note entity.

classes.name: NoteMapper
classes.description: Utility class for mapping between Note entity and its DTO representations.

methods.name: toEntity
methods.description: Converts a NoteRequest DTO into a Note entity by setting the title and content.

methods.name: updateEntity
methods.description: Updates an existing Note entity with data from a NoteRequest DTO.

methods.name: toResponse
methods.description: Creates a NoteResponse DTO from a Note entity, including its id, title, content, and timestamps.
